channel.title: Ghostex Updates
channel.description: Sparkle appcast for Ghostex macOS releases.

item.description:
# Ghostex 10.25.0
## 10.25.0 - 2026-10-17
**Ghostex 10.25.0 is out.** Update Ghostex on your other computers from anywhere, find any project file with Cmd+O, open CSV, JSON, PDF, SQLite and font files right in Files, chat with OpenCode 2 with live replies, and the phone reconnects on its own after being in the background.
### 📂 Files - **Cmd+O finds files:** Quick Access has a Files tab that searches every project's files, the current project first, and Cmd+5 switches to it while Quick Access is open; Enter opens the file in Files. - **Settings > File opening has two dropdowns,** one for HTML, Markdown and images and one for every other file, offering Files, the Code view, VS Code, Cursor, Zed, the JetBrains IDEs and the other editors you have installed; your earlier Markdown, HTML and image choices are kept. - **CSV and TSV files open as a table** you can sort by column and copy from, with a Raw button for the text. - **JSON files get Format, Minify and a Tree view** that folds, searches and copies a value's path. - **PDFs open in the built-in PDF viewer,** AVIF pictures show like any other picture, and font files open as a preview with sample text, weights and their characters. - **SQLite databases open read-only:** pick a table to page through its rows or run a SELECT query. - **Dockerfiles, PowerShell scripts and Terraform files are coloured,** and so are .env, .gitignore, .ini and .jsonl files; notebooks open in the Code view. - **Zip, Office and other files Files can't show open in their own app** instead of a "not previewed" message. - **Typing in a long Markdown file with notes stays fast,** and undo and redo update the view.
### 💬 Chat - **Every file in the chat has Copy Path and Open File Location,** and Open in Files works for every file except folders and media; on the phone Copy Path is in the long-press menu. - **Grey thinking** (Settings > Chat, off by default) shows the agent's thinking in grey and its replies in the full text colour, on the computer and the phone. - **The Previous question pill shows an amber dot that pings** when a question arrives and every 30 seconds while any is unanswered. - **When an agent writes questions Ghostex can't show,** Ghostex asks it once to send them again in the right format. - **An interrupted turn reads "Agent was interrupted",** and Skip all is a soft fill so it no longer looks disabled. - **A Claude chat resumed after a while keeps its last reply visible** instead of folding it away behind a long Worked time. - **Page questions show a green check as soon as you answer them,** and questions you already answered or that were asked again no longer come back as unanswered.
### 🌐 Remote computers - **Update Ghostex on a remote computer** from Settings > Remote, its tab in the sidebar or `ghostex app-update`, with progress, while its agents keep running; turn on Keep this machine up to date to install updates while none of its agents is working. It works on computers running this release or later, so update older ones once by hand. - **Pages, localhost pictures and Browser links from a remote session open through the connection to that computer** instead of this computer's 127.0.0.1. - **The Code view opens for a session on a remote Mac** from any computer, including Windows.
### 🤖 Agents - **OpenCode 2 chats stream replies and reasoning live,** and accept-all, resume, prompt search and the installer work with OpenCode 2; OpenCode 1 is no longer supported. - **Windows: Hermes Agent can use its tools again;** its hooks no longer block every tool call. - **An agent CLI install or update that is refused says why.**
### 🧭 Browser - **A phone button in the Browser toolbar shows a tab at phone or tablet size,** with an optional mobile user agent, saved per tab. - **macOS: clicking a saved autofill suggestion fills the field,** and so do Down and Enter. - **The Browser no longer offers to save passwords** or sign you in automatically.
### ⚙️ Settings - **Settings stays open when you switch apps** and reopens on the same page, scroll position and open form; the Add machine dialog keeps what you typed (not the password) across restarts. - **The Actions, custom agent, Cloud Boxes, Extensions and Add account forms reopen with what you typed,** never a sign-in code or secret. - **The Theme page's + square opens the colour picker,** and Colourfulness sets how deep a custom colour is.
### 📱 On the phone - **The phone reconnects on its own after being in the background,** instead of needing a force-quit. - **iOS terminal: a long press always shows Paste,** Cmd+V on a keyboard pastes without asking each time, and a multi-line paste into a program without safe paste asks first, on Android too. - **Wide tables in chat scroll sideways.** - **The web preview has a Desktop site switch,** remembered for each site. - **The Machines list shows each computer's Ghostex version** and can update it. - **Links, pages, pictures, video, audio, PDFs and drawings from a computer open through the phone's connection to it,** from anywhere on that computer.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **Capture no longer crashes on a Mac without Screen Recording permission,** and its windows have no traffic lights. - **Restarting or updating Ghostex never leaves gxserver stuck,** so the app reconnects within seconds. - **Tooltip text is centred** instead of sitting low. - **The Notifications panel has more room around its title.** - **Start Agent in Send Bug / Feedback runs in the Ghostex settings folder,** which every agent trusts. - **Connectors (experimental): Settings > Connectors, per-workspace gh and gws sign-ins,** and the Connectors helper no longer slows Ghostex down.

# Ghostex 10.24.0
## 10.24.0 - 2026-10-16
**Ghostex 10.24.0 is out.** Send Bug / Feedback can hand your report to an agent that gathers the details and files it, and it's on the phone too; question cards send blank questions as skipped and can send on a single pick; programs can report their own session status; Windows gets a real choice of window blur and a transparency strength that goes all the way to clear; and Source opens again for WSL projects.
### 🐞 Send Bug / Feedback - **Send Feedback is now Send Bug / Feedback,** and it asks for your GitHub username first, so GitHub tells you when your report is fixed: the issue opens with "Reported by @you". - **Collect more data with an agent:** turn it on and Start Agent hands your description and screenshots to your default agent, which gathers the version, settings and logs that help, shows you the full draft in its chat, and files the issue only after you say yes. - **The phone has Send Bug / Feedback too,** in the Sessions menu after Settings, with screenshots from your photos or the clipboard. It posts even when it can't reach your computer, and while a computer is connected it can start the agent there. - **Agents can file an issue themselves** with `ghostex feedback send`, which also shows the exact request with `--dry-run`.
### 💬 Chat - **A question you leave blank is sent as skipped,** so a form goes out with Send answers whatever you answered; the separate Skip row on every question is gone, and Skip all still sends at once. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Send when you pick an answer:** turn it on in Settings > Chat (under Show Advanced) and a card that asks one single-choice question sends the moment you pick, thanks to @larik-PR. - **Skip all and Send answers show their shortcuts in a quick tooltip** instead of key labels, and Skip all wears Send's colours a shade darker. - **Claude's dialogs become numbered choice cards,** with rare actions folded under More, and Claude menus with tabs or bullets get clickable rows. - **A tool call or file edit waiting for your approval opens by itself,** showing its command or diff, and folds back once you answer. - **The panels above the composer become one row of pills** on the Working line (scroll to bottom, previous question, threads, tasks, subagents, background work), each opening its own list. - **Pictures in a reply show as a filmstrip,** pictures in your own messages are small thumbnails again, and question tags are outline pills that show whether they were answered. - **A connection or server error retries quickly first** and shows as a card with the retry state, Retry now and Stop retrying. - **An agent that couldn't start shows the start command's error lines** instead of waiting at Starting. - **A described tool call reads its description in every mode,** and with Simple mode off the work under each reply starts open. - **Files and links moves into the ⋯ menu,** and Maximize chat box and Files and links get hotkeys. - **The zoom keys change one saved chat zoom** that every chat follows, and messages from or to an orchestrator show its crown.
### 🚦 Session status - **Programs can report their own status:** Claude Code 2.1.295 and later, Codex betas and your own scripts send it, and Settings > Sidebar > Session status from picks Detection, Combined or Program status only. - **A session whose program reports an error gets a red dot,** and its long-press menu on the phone shows the program's own status line.
### 🪟 Windows - **Blur on Windows:** with Desktop and windows behind the glass, pick Acrylic, Plain blur or Off in Settings > Theme > Transparency; Acrylic now stays blurred when Ghostex isn't the focused window. - **Transparency Strength goes from nearly solid to fully clear** across the whole window, including an empty work area and session placeholders (on every platform). - **Source opens for WSL projects again:** Ghostex no longer gives up while it prepares the Linux editor, and it clears a VS Code an older version left holding its port. - **Ghostex installs its own build of Claude Swap on Windows,** which shares history between accounts and adds folder trust to session profiles.
### 🎨 Theme and Settings - **Background opacity and Background blur** in Settings > Terminal make terminals see-through on their own, and the strip under a terminal's agent bar matches them. - **A calmer Theme page** with Appearance preview cards, one Transparency choice and smaller colour squares. - **Every tooltip is a small menu with key caps,** frosted under window glass. - **Settings opens bigger,** Accounts is a list with a detail page and one-click Reconnect, and an account's Enabled switch keeps it saved but out of use. - **Dragging an expanded row in Settings > Agents collapses it first,** and the Extensions page links to the related settings.
### 🧭 Orchestrators - **Threads rename themselves** after the area they own, and a thread can be unlinked into a standalone session. - **Orchestrators can see and fix accounts:** `ghostex accounts` lists every account with its usage, and `ghostex agents switch-account` and `ghostex agents reload` move or restart a stuck thread. - **A restored session keeps its launch settings, account and model,** and a restored orchestrator keeps its threads and notes.
### 📂 Files - **A wrap button replaces Refresh,** and open files follow changes on disk, like VS Code. - **A code file fills the view,** with the path shown once and a see-through gutter under window glass.
### 🔌 Connectors (experimental) - **Each workspace can connect apps** through Executor or Composio, sign them in and run tools that only read. Turn on Enable Experimental Features to see Connectors.
### 📱 On the phone - **On iOS a long press on the terminal opens Paste,** and it pastes without the Allow Paste prompt. - **Easy Connect finds Ghostex on a Windows computer where it's installed just for you,** and shows a computer's errors as plain text. - **The Android app is smaller:** the APK ships for 64-bit phones only, compressed.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **An old file Ghostex can't move into its new storage folder no longer stops it from starting** (#231). - **Leaving an empty chat never closes it** (#236), and the first-run intro opens on a still picture with Play and fits small screens (#237). - **A session whose worktree folder was deleted reopens in the project folder.** - **Skills show one row per skill in the Agents Hub,** with one shared copy in ~/.agents/skills. - **ZCode sessions show Working and Attention again,** chat sends reach ZCode 3.15, and a failed ZCode turn no longer leaves its session working. - **A Claude conversation moved into Claude's background daemon keeps its chat,** and taking back a queued Claude message works with an empty queue. - **Codex's /status shows its output every time,** and /diff's text reaches the chat. - **`ghostex logs` shows the newest lines,** and `ghostex remove-project` takes a project's name or path. - **Cmd+Backspace clears the line like Ghostty,** and the web app on a Mac gets the Mac editing keys and Cmd shortcuts. - **Linux: a click inside a page window no longer closes it.**

# Ghostex 10.23.0
## 10.23.0 - 2026-10-14
**Ghostex 10.23.0 is out.** Question forms take a closing note and answers show at once, sent agent messages turn Delivered when they arrive, orchestrators get Sleep Inactive Threads and editors for their goal and memory, closed sessions come back from anywhere, SpaceO gets a guided permission setup on macOS, and agents start properly under WSL with zsh and Powerlevel10k.
### 💬 Chat - **A question form with more than one question ends with an optional notes box** for anything else you want the agent to know; it arrives with your answers. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Answers show at once:** a question form or page reads Answered the moment you send, and your answers appear right away as a pending card that settles once the agent has them. - **A Previous question ↑ button** beside Scroll to bottom jumps to the next unanswered question; turn it on in Settings > Chat > Previous question button. Q-tags in an agent's reply (Q80) link to the question they name. - **A message one agent sends another now turns Delivered** once the other session takes it, or Not sent with the reason, instead of staying on Waiting for agent. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **In summary mode the turn that is still running shows its work open,** with the running command visible, and folds into the reply once the turn ends. - **Simple mode names a tool call by the description the agent gave it** instead of the tool's name. - **An agent that can't start says why:** a missing account login becomes a card with Switch account, Sign in and Try again, and a message waiting for that agent goes out once it is up. - **Antigravity CLI's Run this command? panel becomes a permission card in the chat,** and its folder-trust card answers from the chat again. - **Cmd+Enter on a folder-trust card picks Yes, I trust,** and links in the chat no longer show an underline. - **A marked section's label stands on its own line,** with the text that followed it underneath.
### 🧭 Orchestrators - **Sleep Inactive Threads** on an orchestrator's right-click menu sleeps every one of its threads that is idle. On the computer and the phone. - **Goal & Instructions and Memory editors** open from an orchestrator's menu, and a thread's menu has Mark Thread Done and Reopen Thread, each saying why when a session can't close or wake. On the computer and the phone.
### 🗂️ Sessions and sidebar - **Closed sessions come back from anywhere:** `ghostex previous-sessions` lists them and `ghostex restore-previous-session` restores one, and the phone's session search lists closed sessions and restores the one you tap. - **Every project always shows all its sessions:** the compact list and Show more / Show less are gone, on the computer and the phone. - **Send Feedback moved into the sidebar's More options menu,** under Join Discord, and takes an optional GitHub username so you hear back on GitHub when your report is fixed. - **Sleep Below skips sessions that are running a shell command or asking a question.** - **A row's menu opens where you right-clicked,** or lined up with the button that opened it. - **Session hotkeys act on a focused side-panel view:** with Kanban, Files or the Browser focused, Close, Previous/Next Tab, Sleep, Reload, Cmd+F and Cmd+R work on that view.
### 📂 Files - **Open With starts with Show in Folder** for a file on your computer, which shows it selected in File Explorer (Finder on a Mac).
### 🔐 macOS permissions - **SpaceO and Fast Computer & Browser Use each ask macOS for their own permissions,** and Settings > Integrations shows Granted, Not granted or Needs restart for each one. - **A guide beside System Settings walks you through SpaceO's permissions:** drag SpaceO from the tag into the list, it moves to the other side when there is no room, and SpaceO restarts by itself once its agents are done. - **SpaceO updates from the same Update button as Fast Computer & Browser Use.**
### 🤖 Agents and accounts - **Codex's Update now updates the copy your sessions actually run,** with the tool that installed it, then restarts Codex once it is idle. - **`ghostex create-agent` and the board set an Antigravity CLI worker's model and effort at launch.** - **Switching a session's account answers the folder-trust prompt once,** including for an account that never ran in that folder, and Sign in again works when the default Claude profile is signed out.
### 🐧 Linux and Windows - **Agents start properly under zsh with Powerlevel10k:** Codex no longer quits with "stdin is not a terminal" in WSL (and on Linux and macOS), thanks to @omegafrog for the report. - **WSL sessions no longer take `C:\WINDOWS\system32\wsl.exe` as their name;** sessions already named that way go back to their usual name.
### 🖥️ Terminal - **Ghostex terminals have their own Ghostty config,** so Settings > Terminal never writes to the Ghostty app's config again; your current look is copied over once, and Import from Ghostty brings over fonts, spacing and the cursor whenever you want.
### 🎨 Look - **Every text button in the app's dialogs, Settings and chat cards is filled;** secondary actions take one neutral fill, on the computer and the phone. - **Settings > Chat: Show marker emojis comes before Marked sections style,** and Preview is a labelled button beside the style dropdown.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **`ghostex show` embeds images a page points to by a relative path,** and a page with inlined images is no longer refused for its source size. - **Closing a session ends the messages it was holding,** so it can't come back by itself. - **Starting an agent that is turned off in Settings > Agents from the CLI is refused** and names the agents you can use, unless you pass `--allow-hidden`. - **Settings' scrollbars look and sit like the chat's,** and the rail's no longer covers its rows. - **The Goal & Instructions and Memory editors stay open until the save succeeds.**

# Ghostex 10.22.0
## 10.22.0 - 2026-10-13
**Ghostex 10.22.0 is out.** A Files and links card lists everything a session mentioned, the Kanban board scrolls with a mouse and opens in a window of its own, the Work panel shows formatted Markdown, and Ghostex has a new app icon.
### 💬 Chat - **Files and links:** a link button in the chat box's toolbar opens a card listing every attachment, file and link the session mentioned, with a filter and counts; each row opens its item or jumps to the message that mentioned it. For an orchestrator it covers its own chat and every thread, grouped by thread. On the computer, the web and the phone. - **Catch me up shows only while the chat box is empty,** fades in and out, and reads the last 30 agent messages. - **A tool group's line** is the same thin hairline as the Worked fold's. - **macOS: Cmd+V pastes into the chat box again** instead of into the terminal behind the chat, thanks to @banozz0.
### 🗂️ Kanban - **The board scrolls sideways with a mouse:** drag the bar under the lanes or use Shift+wheel, each lane has its own scrollbar, and dragging a card to the board's edge scrolls the board, thanks to @landygg. - **Open in New Window** moves the board to a window of its own, for a second screen; the panel shows Show Window and Bring Back, and the window follows the project you switch to, thanks to @landygg.
### 🧩 Work Mode - **The Work panel shows Markdown:** ticket descriptions and comments, Slack messages and pull request bodies show headings, lists, checklists, tables, code and links. - **Video comes right after PR** in the team flow, and "Working thread" is now an optional "Slack thread" step: an optional step shows a grey "?" until it's done. Mark any step optional in Settings > Workspaces > Team-flow steps; a team's owner runs `ghostex team deploy` once so the team can save it. - **A session card shows its ticket's new pull request** within moments of it being opened, instead of minutes later.
### 🌸 App icon - **A new seven-petal app icon** on the computer and the phone.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **macOS: the sidebar button sits further from the window buttons,** thanks to @TheOrcDev. - **An account is no longer marked disabled** because a CLI started by hand in a session's terminal was refused on a different login.

# Ghostex 10.21.0
## 10.21.0 - 2026-10-12
**Ghostex 10.21.0 is out.** A Catch me up button tells you where a session stands, a message an agent queued comes back to your chat box with ↑, renaming a session shows the new name at once, messages between agents name the other session, and on Windows a restart or update takes over in seconds instead of showing the startup dialog.
### 💬 Chat - **Catch me up:** a button at the top right of the chat box has a small model read the session's recent conversation and shows a coloured handover (what needs you, what's done, what's in progress) in a card above the chat box, with Refresh, Copy and Close. Off by default: turn it on in Settings > Chat > Catch me up button. - **Back to composer:** a message Claude Code is still holding in its queue gets Back to composer in its actions, and ↑ in an empty chat box takes back the newest one, like ↑ in Claude's own input. Its text and pictures are added to your draft unsent, and any other queued messages stay queued. - **Messages between agents name the other session:** a row reads Message from "<session>" or Message to "<session>" and opens to the whole message; one command that sends the same message to several sessions is one "Message to 2 sessions" row listing each recipient, and a session that can't be found reads "another agent" instead of a raw code. - **Answered question forms fold to one line** with their title and Answered (click to open the form again), and your answers below read as plain text, each question with your answer under it; the agent's own question receipts look the same. - **Needs you is orange** in marked handovers, so it no longer looks like In progress. - **Section labels wrap and their links work:** a long marked label (for example a pull request title with its link) wraps like a paragraph and its link is clickable. - **A `!` command's copy button** floats outside the bubble on its left, like other messages, and the bubble no longer says Running. - **The Worked row** shows only its tool-call and file counts; a failed call still shows on its own row. - **The text caret is 1 pixel wide** in the chat box and every text field.
### 📋 Sidebar - **Renaming a session shows the new name at once,** and the agent's confirmation reaches every computer and the phone within about a quarter second instead of 3–4 seconds. If the agent never takes the name, the old one comes back with a shake and Rename reopens with the name you tried.
### 🧭 Orchestrators - **A message to a sleeping thread wakes it** and keeps retrying until it's delivered, and reopening a thread wakes it too; a message that waited more than a day is marked Not sent instead of waking an old session. - **Handovers list each thread once,** under Kicked off or In progress, and question numbers keep counting across the whole conversation.
### 📱 On the phone - **Hold a message to see its actions:** copy, edit, Back to composer, rewind and the rest open on a long press, in the main chat and the subagent viewer, and nothing shows under a message until you do.
### 🪟 Windows - **Restarts and updates take over in seconds:** a leftover gxserver of an older build is replaced right away, and startup checks only the sessions that need it, so Ghostex no longer waits minutes or shows the startup diagnostics dialog. - **Hovering a message while typing no longer blinks** its buttons and time.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish - **Sending feedback says why GitHub refused it** instead of a generic "try again", and a refused send can be sent again right away.

# Ghostex 10.20.1
## 10.20.1 - 2026-10-11
**Ghostex 10.20.1 is out.** Messages with pictures wait for a slow-starting agent too, sessions move to an account with room faster when they hit a usage limit, and chat cards sit darker.
### 💬 Chat - **Messages with pictures wait for a slow-starting agent** instead of giving up after 40 seconds; Ghostex keeps its own copy of each picture until the message goes through. - **Chat cards sit darker** and question cards use a softer yellow, matching the question cards on agents' pages. - **A finished background task just says it completed;** "exit code 0" and the duration are gone, and a failed task still shows its exit code.
### 🤖 Accounts - **A session that hits its usage limit moves to an account with room within about 30 seconds,** instead of waiting minutes for a fresh usage reading. - **A sleeping session wakes on an account with room** when its own account is already at its limit. - **When every account is full,** the chat shows a card saying which limit was hit and when work continues, and the bell gets one notification.
